name: MakinaRocks Co., Ltd.
summary: MakinaRocks Co., Ltd., established in 2017 and based in Seoul, South Korea, specializes in developing Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions for various industrial applications. The company's offerings include Runway, an enterprise-grade AI operating system, and DrawX, an AI agent designed to standardize engineering drawing data. Its clientele spans diverse sectors, such as automotive, defense, heavy industries, and general manufacturing.
